notes: FY2025 and FY2024 profit after tax are attributable to ordinary equity holders (R3,864m and R4,827m; totals including non-controlling interest R3,971m and R4,947m).

Profit Before Tax and Income Tax rows are continuing operations only and exclude discontinued operations: R5,312m in FY2025 (Life Molecular Imaging disposal) and R3,413m in FY2024 (Alliance Medical disposal).
The Operating Profit (EBIT) row excludes the R2,881m FY2025 fair value adjustment on the Piramal liability, which is inside Profit Before Tax.
